_comment: REAL REVIEWS ONLY. The rating and count below were verified against public listings citing Google on 2026-09-03. Re-check them every few months and update `verifiedAt`. To add quotes, copy them verbatim from the Google Business profile: `author` as the reviewer signs it, `text` word for word (trim with … if long), `date` as YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, `lang` the language it was written in. Never write a quote that nobody left. With `quotes` empty the band still shows the rating; the quote row simply does not render.
